description: Presidential Secretariat - Presidential Commission of Inquiry
reasoning: This gazette content establishes a Commission of Inquiry to investigate potential wrongdoing at the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. It references the Commissions of Inquiry Act (Chapter 393) and outlines the legal framework, scope, and powers of the commission. The content focuses on legal procedures, statutory compliance, and investigation mandates rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it deals with the establishment of a legal investigative body and its operating framework.
